metadata.name: polypad_exchange
metadata.description: Polypad exchange: signed-quote oracle, pTokens and the USDC float (Solana port of PriceOracle + PExchange)

instructions.name: absorb
docs: Burn pToken the exchange holds beyond delayed-sale stock: in `held`,
and in `other` if passed (the config PDA's associated token account,
or any pToken account it owns). Anyone.

accounts.name: other
docs: Optional: another pToken account of this market the exchange PDA owns,
normally its associated token account; all of it is burned.

instructions.name: accept_signer
docs: Accept the proposed signer, after `ROLE_DELAY` and within `ACCEPT_WINDOW`
of it, so a forgotten proposal cannot be accepted months later.

instructions.name: cancel
docs: Undo a delayed sale before it is released. Owner; works while halted.

instructions.name: cancel_settle
docs: Withdraw a settlement that has not taken effect yet (a wrong or forged
payout). The market goes back to how it was before it: paused only if
it already was. The keeper that recorded it can no longer settle here.

instructions.name: close_fill
docs: Close an expired quote's fill record; its rent goes back to whoever
paid it. Anyone, once the quote is past `valid_until + MAX_VALIDITY`:
it can never verify again, so its fill can never be needed.

instructions.name: create_market
docs: The market and its pToken, created on first use (`ensurePToken`); a
second call for the same market changes nothing. Factory or owner.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The factory (the launch program's signer) or the owner.

accounts.name: ptoken_mint
docs: Classic SPL Token, 6 decimals, minted only by the exchange PDA, no freeze authority.

instructions.name: halt
docs: Stop every mint, redeem, release and queue payment. The keeper may halt; only the owner resumes.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Create the config and the float vault. Only the program's upgrade
authority can, so nobody can front-run the deployment with their own
owner. The USDC mint is pinned here for good.

accounts.name: payer
docs: The program's upgrade authority: nobody else can take the config first.

instructions.name: mint
docs: Pay USDC, receive pToken at the quoted buy price plus the buy spread;
or at the payout plus the spread when one applies (quote ignored).
The transaction's previous instruction must be the ed25519
verification of `quote` by the oracle signer.

accounts.name: to
docs: Receives the pToken.

instructions.name: mint_at_payout
docs: A mint with no quote: the market is settled at a payout, or has a $1
payout recorded and still inside its delay. A $0 payout refuses.

instructions.name: pay_queue
docs: Pay up to `max` queued claims, oldest first, while the float covers
them. Anyone may call.

instructions.name: preview_mint
docs: pToken a mint of `usdc_in` at `price` would pay (`mintOut`). Read-only.

instructions.name: preview_redeem
docs: USDC a redemption of `amount_in` at `price` would pay, at a quote or
(`settled`) at a payout (`redeemOut`). Before any outflow cap or queue. Read-only.

instructions.name: redeem
docs: Burn pToken, receive USDC at the quoted sell price minus the sell
spread, or at the payout less the settle fee once the market has
settled (quote ignored). Works on a paused market.

accounts.name: to
docs: Receives the USDC.

accounts.name: new_claim
docs: if part of the payment queues.

accounts.name: new_ticket
docs: only if part of the sale passes the hourly cap.

instructions.name: redeem_at_payout
docs: Redeem a settled market at its payout less the settle fee. No quote.

instructions.name: refresh_risk
docs: Bring markets' stored risk down to what their unbacked supply can carry
now (or to 0 once settled). Only ever lowers it; anyone may call.
`remaining_accounts` holds `(market, pToken mint)` pairs.

instructions.name: release
docs: Pay a delayed sale once `DELAY` has passed. Anyone may call.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Pays the rent of any claim the payment creates.

accounts.name: to
docs: paying (it may have been closed or frozen since the sale).

accounts.name: new_claim
docs: if part of the payment queues.

accounts.name: new_aside
docs: if the recipient cannot be paid and the payment is set aside.

instructions.name: report_backed
docs: Shares the desk holds on Polymarket, per market, as it read them when
each market's `burned_total` was `seen` and its `minted_total` was
`minted` (one read of the market, taken before the holdings).
`remaining_accounts` holds `(market, pToken mint)` pairs in the order
of `amounts`. Keeper. A report against another state (a keeper bug)
is skipped, not refused, so it cannot stop the rest of the batch; the
market is stored all the same, as the visit booked any direct burns
into it and into `total_risk` alike.

instructions.name: rescue
docs: Return tokens sent to the exchange by mistake. Never USDC or a pToken.

instructions.name: send_to_bridge
docs: Move float to the desk's Polymarket deposit account, never more than
the free float (USDC owed to the queue stays). Keeper; not stopped by
`halt`, so the desk can still be funded to pay the queue.

accounts.name: bridge
docs: The destination is fixed by the owner.

instructions.name: set_max_risk
docs: A market's own risk cap, USDC; 0 = the default. Owner.

instructions.name: set_outflow_cap
docs: The hourly redemption cap: `float_bps` of the float, never below
`floor`. At most 100%: a cap above the float would never bind.

instructions.name: set_params
docs: Spreads at most 5%; the band inside [0.1c, $1).

instructions.name: set_paused
docs: Pause or unpause the markets in `remaining_accounts`. Keeper.

instructions.name: set_roles
docs: Set the keeper and factory. The bridge deposit can be set here only the
first time; after that it changes through `propose_bridge_deposit` with
a `BRIDGE_DELAY`, since it is where the float may be sent. Clearing is
instant; only the very first bridge skips the delay, so a clear
followed by a set cannot install a new one at once.

instructions.name: set_share_label
docs: Name a market's share after its outcome. Keeper or owner. Kept on the
market account (Metaplex metadata is a later step).

instructions.name: set_signer
docs: Change the quote signer. A new signer takes effect `ROLE_DELAY` after
this (via `accept_signer`), so a stolen owner key cannot start signing
prices before anyone notices. Default revokes at once.

instructions.name: settle
docs: Record the final payout per share, 0..$1. It takes effect after
`SETTLE_DELAY`, and buying stops at once. One-way once in effect.
Keeper or owner; a keeper whose settlement on this market the owner
cancelled may not record another there (its key may be stolen); a new
keeper may.

instructions.name: transfer_ownership
docs: Start a two-step ownership transfer. There is no renounce: a program
without an owner could never be resumed or reconfigured. Default
cancels a pending transfer.

instructions.name: view_float
docs: The float and the queue now (`freeFloat`, `outflowRemaining`,
`queueLength`, `delayedLength`). Read-only: call it in a simulation.

instructions.name: view_market
docs: One market now (`oracle.status`, `oracle.settlement`, `maxRisk`, the
supply and backing, and the `seen` a keeper reports against). Read-only.

instructions.name: withdraw_unclaimed
docs: Pay a set-aside claim to the account it was owed to. Anyone may call,
for a recipient that cannot call itself; not stopped by `halt`.

errors.name: WrongSide
errors.msg: quote is for the other side

errors.name: QuoteTooLong
errors.msg: quote valid for longer than MAX_VALIDITY

errors.name: PriceOutOfRange
errors.msg: price outside (0, MAX_PRICE] for a quote, or above $1 for a payout

errors.name: NotEd25519
errors.msg: no ed25519 verification right before this instruction

errors.name: BadEd25519Header
errors.msg: ed25519 instruction is malformed or reads outside its own data

errors.name: BadSignature
errors.msg: quote not signed by the oracle signer

errors.name: OnlyFactory
errors.msg: only the factory or the owner

errors.name: QuoteTooSmall
errors.msg: quote does not cover this size

errors.name: BridgeChangeDelayed
errors.msg: the bridge deposit changes through propose/accept

errors.name: NotRescuable
errors.msg: the float and pTokens cannot be rescued

errors.name: SettledAtZero
errors.msg: market settled at $0: nothing to mint

errors.name: DustOverCap
errors.msg: under MIN_DELAYED over a spent cap

errors.name: NotAtPayout
errors.msg: no settlement pays here: the market is open

errors.name: MissingAccount
errors.msg: an account this instruction needs was not passed

errors.name: WrongAccount
errors.msg: an account is not the one expected

errors.name: FloatFrozen
errors.msg: the float is frozen: no payment can be made

types.name: Claim
docs: USDC owed to `to` (a USDC token account). In line at `["claim", index]`
until paid; a claim whose recipient cannot be paid is set aside for its
owner (`set_aside`), as are payments a release could not deliver
(`["aside", index]`). Set-aside claims are paid only to `to`, by
`withdraw_unclaimed`.

types.name: ClaimUndelivered
docs: A queued claim whose recipient could not be paid: set aside for its owner.

types.name: Config
docs: `PriceOracle` + `PExchange` contract-wide state. PDA `["exchange"]`; it is
also the authority of the float vault and every pToken mint.

fields.name: pending_owner
docs: Two-step ownership: the new owner accepts.

fields.name: keeper
docs: Pauses and settles markets, reports backing, sends float to the bridge, may halt.

fields.name: factory
docs: May create pTokens for new markets (the launch program's signer).

fields.name: signer
docs: Signs quotes (ed25519). Default = revoked: no quote verifies.

fields.name: usdc_mint
docs: Pinned at initialize: the only mint the float is held in.

fields.name: bridge_deposit
docs: Polymarket bridge deposit token account. Default = none.

fields.name: bridge_ever_set
docs: Set once a bridge deposit has been in place; later ones wait BRIDGE_DELAY.

fields.name: halted
docs: Every mint, redeem, release and queue payment refused while set.

fields.name: settle_fee_bps
docs: Fee on redemptions of a settled market, bps of the payout.

fields.name: meter_sales
docs: Whether sales at a quote count against the hourly cap too. Payouts of
settled markets always do.

fields.name: default_max_risk
docs: USDC a market's unbacked supply may lose if its price went to $1, unless overridden.

fields.name: max_total_risk
docs: USDC all markets' unbacked supply together may lose.

fields.name: total_risk
docs: Sum of every market's stored `risk`, 12 decimals.

fields.name: outflow_floor
docs: The hourly redemption cap is never below this, USDC.

fields.name: outflow_float_bps
docs: The hourly redemption cap as a share of the float, bps.

fields.name: queued
docs: USDC owed to the queue, including claims set aside for their owners.

fields.name: unclaimed_total
docs: Set-aside claims' USDC: reserved for those owners, never paid to the queue.

fields.name: claim_head
docs: The queue is `claim_head..claim_tail`, oldest first.

fields.name: aside_next
docs: Next index for a claim set aside at a release (its own namespace, never in line).

fields.name: delayed_next
docs: Next delayed-sale ticket.

types.name: DelayedSale
docs: The part of a sale over the hourly cap: `p_amount` pToken held in the
market's `held` account, owed `amount` USDC once released. PDA
`["delayed", ticket]`, closed when released or cancelled.

fields.name: to
docs: USDC token account the sale pays.

fields.name: to_owner
docs: That account's owner at the sale: a cancel returns the pToken to them.

types.name: FloatView
docs: The float and the queue, as the next instruction would see them.

fields.name: vault
docs: USDC in the float vault.

fields.name: free_float
docs: What can pay a redemption now or go to the bridge (`freeFloat`).

fields.name: claim_head
docs: Next claim in line and the next index a claim would take: the queue
is `claim_head..claim_tail` (`queueLength` is their difference).

fields.name: aside_next
docs: Next set-aside claim index and next delayed-sale ticket (`delayedLength`).

fields.name: outflow_remaining
docs: USDC metered redemptions may still pay this sliding hour (`outflowRemaining`).

types.name: HourFloat
docs: The free float at the first mint or redeem of `hour`, before that trade
moved it (`amount`), and the hour's cap base: the lower of it and the last
such snapshot (`base`).

types.name: Market
docs: One market: the oracle's `Status` and the exchange's per-market mappings.
PDA `["market", position_id]`.

fields.name: position_id
docs: The CTF position id (also the CLOB token id), big-endian: the EVM uint256.

fields.name: mint
docs: pToken mint, PDA `["ptoken", position_id]`.

fields.name: held
docs: The exchange's own pToken account, PDA `["held", position_id]`: shares
held for delayed sales, and fee shares sent here to be absorbed (as
may any other pToken account the exchange PDA owns, its associated
token account included).

fields.name: paused_before_settle
docs: Whether it was paused before a settlement was recorded, to restore on cancel.

fields.name: settle_at
docs: When the payout takes effect; 0 = not settled.

fields.name: settled_by
docs: Who recorded the settlement now pending or in effect.

fields.name: barred
docs: A keeper whose settlement here the owner cancelled: it may not record another.

fields.name: backed
docs: Shares the desk holds on Polymarket, as last reported, less burns since.

fields.name: max_risk_override
docs: 0 = use `default_max_risk`.

fields.name: risk
docs: What the unbacked supply could cost to cover at $1: shares x (1 - price), 12 decimals.

fields.name: low
docs: Lowest price minted at since the market was last fully backed (0 = unknown, taken as $0).

fields.name: high
docs: Highest price minted at since then (ONE = unknown, taken as $1).

fields.name: minted_since_report
docs: Shares minted since the keeper last reported the market.

fields.name: minted_total
docs: Every share the exchange has ever minted in this market.

fields.name: burned_total
docs: Every share ever burned in this market. Holders can burn their own
pTokens straight through the token program, which the exchange never
sees; each instruction that reads the supply first counts those, so
afterwards `burned_total == minted_total - supply` (`Config::burned_outside`).

fields.name: low_supply
docs: The lowest supply seen since the last backing report (the supply
then, lowered by every burn; a direct burn shows at the next
instruction, before any mint can lift the supply again). The desk
sells only shares beyond the supply, so whatever it read since that
report it still holds at least down to this (`Config::report`).

fields.name: burned_at_report
docs: `burned_total` at the last backing report: how low the supply could
have gone between a read taken before that report and the report.

fields.name: delayed_shares
docs: pToken held in `held` for live delayed sales: `absorb` leaves it alone.

types.name: MarketView
docs: One market, as the next instruction would see it: burns made straight
through the token program are already counted.

fields.name: burned_total
docs: Every share burned so far, direct burns included: the `seen` a keeper
passes to `report_backed` with the holdings it reads now.

fields.name: risk
docs: Stored risk (12 decimals) and the market's cap in USDC (`maxRisk`).

fields.name: settled
docs: A payout is in effect: redeem and mint at it with no quote.

fields.name: mints_at_payout
docs: A mint prices at the payout (settled, or a pending $1 payout).

fields.name: settle_at
docs: When the payout takes effect; 0 = none recorded.

types.name: Outflow
docs: Metered USDC per clock hour. The EVM mapping is only ever read for the
current hour and the one before, so two slots hold all of it.

types.name: QuoteFill
docs: How much of one signed quote has been used (the EVM `quoteFilled[digest]`).
PDA `["fill", sha256(message)]`.

fields.name: payer
docs: Who paid the rent; `close_fill` refunds them.

types.name: SetAside
docs: A release that could not pay its recipient: set aside at `claim`
(`["aside", index]`). The EVM adds it to `unclaimed[to]` silently.
